# Controlled Company, Controlled Story — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-loc-gtfy-00717
Voiceover: One frame holds a named designer, a model, a photographer, a collection, and an institutional record—separate roles that public shorthand often compresses.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Bernard Gotfryd photograph collection, Library of Congress Prints and Photographs Division

### 8–16s — CO05-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · VOTE — What does the vote actually reach?. Record security class, votes per share, ownership date, agreements, transfer limits, quorum, reserved matters, and the exact filing. Do not convert disclosed voting power into a claim about every creative decision.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CO05-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · BOARD — Who directs the corporation?. For a Delaware corporation, inspect certificate, bylaws, board composition, committee and delegation records with §141. Founder status alone is not a board rule.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CO05-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · STORY — Which systems shape public memory?. Map archive access, approval language, publicity, account control, historian or curator independence, contributor correction, and disputed records separately from corporate votes.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CO05-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · CONSTRAINT — Who can challenge the controller?. Identify independent directors, contractual rights, worker and collaborator channels, law, fiduciary review, press scrutiny, archive policy, and correction routes without assuming any is effective in a particular company.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 40–48s — S08
Voiceover: Personal Digital Archiving is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Library of Congress

Rights: Link and quote narrowly; check each downloadable resource before redistribution.
